title: Safety on BraidsCommunity
subtitle: Community guidelines for a safe experience for everyone.

verified_studios.title: Verified Studios
verified_studios.desc: Look for the Verified Pro badge, but every Studio is welcome to serve customers.

phone_privacy.title: Phone numbers stay private
phone_privacy.desc: We never share your number with the other party until you agree.

report.title: Report anything that feels wrong
report.desc: Use the Report button on any profile. Three flags from different braiders restricts a customer's ability to book.

pay_at_counter.title: Pay at the counter
pay_at_counter.desc: Payment happens in person between you and the braider. BraidsCommunity does not process payments.

meet_safely.title: Meet in professional locations
meet_safely.desc: Braiders should list a Studio address or agree on a safe public location before the appointment.

legal: By using BraidsCommunity, you agree to treat every member with respect. Discrimination, harassment, and unsafe behavior are grounds for immediate removal.
